name: Brusciano (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Brusciano (a bend and stars on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Brusciano, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Brusciano arms — bend and stars on red, crowned, within branches
